info.title: Pre-Chargeback Alerts API
info.description: Justt official REST API for Pre-Chargeback Alerts. This allows you to retrieve alerts and take actions to prevent chargebacks before they occur.

tags.name: Alerts
tags.description: Operations related to pre-chargeback alerts management

get.description: Retrieving an array of pre-chargeback alerts matching the given criteria. In addition to this endpoint, we also support push notifications that share alerts with you in real-time. Contact your account manager to set up for immediate alert notifications.

parameters.name: reference-account-id
parameters.description: If your account encompasses multiple merchants, you should use this header to specify the account you are working on (https://developers.justt.ai/docs/reference-accounts)

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: The number of items to return between 10 to 100

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: The offset of the first item to return

parameters.name: alertStartDate
parameters.description: Alert creation start date. for date range filtering (ISO 8601 in UTC)

parameters.name: alertEndDate
parameters.description: Alert creation end date. for date range filtering (ISO 8601 in UTC)

parameters.name: startDate
parameters.description: Start date for filtering alerts by creation date in Justt systems (ISO 8601 in UTC)

parameters.name: endDate
parameters.description: End date for filtering alerts by creation date in Justt systems (ISO 8601 in UTC)

parameters.name: providerAlertId
parameters.description: A unique alert Identifier set by the provider

parameters.name: provider
parameters.description: The name of the provider that generated the alert

parameters.name: transactionId
parameters.description: The transaction ID associated with the alert

400.description: In the message you can find explanation of what went wrong, please provide the error ID for our support for future investigation if needed

500.description: In the message you can find explanation of what went wrong, please provide the error ID for our support for future investigation if needed
